# PullUp

> PullUp (pullup.se) is a free event platform: event pages, sign-ups with confirmation mail and calendar invites, a guest list and CRM, and mail to your guests (paid per recipient). It is also the site of Felix Civalero, who runs content and community for brands.

An AI assistant can do on PullUp exactly what its person can do on the site — nothing more.

## Also on pullup.se

- https://pullup.se/stockholm — free guide to what is on in Stockholm, with filters and a Thursday mail.
- PullUp is also an agency in Stockholm: film, growth and direction. Free site check and booking on https://pullup.se.
- https://pullup.se/felix-civalero — Felix Civalero Stolpe, his cases and how he works.

## Connect an assistant

- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.pullup.se — OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE. The person signs in and approves the assistant once at pullup.se/connect, and can disconnect it under Agenter (pullup.se/admin/agents).
- Without an account: https://pullup.se/api/mcp/public — about PullUp, look at an event, sign up to it, ask Felix for a meeting.
- In the browser: pullup.se registers the same actions with WebMCP (document.modelContext), plus sign_in / sign_in_with_code / sign_out and current_page.

## What it can do

Anyone: about_pullup, get_event, rsvp_to_event, request_meeting.
Signed in (an organiser, their own events): whoami, list_brands, create_brand, rename_brand, list_my_events, get_my_event, create_event, update_event (incl. the page design), publish_event, set_event_cover, add_event_image, remove_event_image, move_event, update_guest, list_people, preview_mail, send_mail, list_sent_mail, get_mail_credits, buy_mail_credits.
Statistics: get_stats (a brand; a main brand compares the brands under it), get_event_stats (one event: visits, conversion, sources, returning guests).
Working together: list_team, invite_to_brand, remove_from_team (a brand's head and its team), list_event_cohosts, invite_cohost, remove_cohost (one event), cancel_invite, list_my_invites, accept_invite, decline_invite.

## Rules

- New events are drafts; publish when the person asks.
- A sign-up can ask more than name and email: phone, Instagram, guests brought along and the organiser's own questions (allergies, diet, a choice, a yes). get_event shows the event's signupForm; ask the person those things and pass them to rsvp_to_event. Organisers set it with signupForm in create_event / update_event; the answers show in get_my_event and list_people.
- Times are wall-clock times in the event's time zone (default Europe/Stockholm).
- Mail to a list costs one credit per recipient: preview first, send a test, send only text the person approved. Packs: 5 000 mails 69 kr, 25 000 299 kr, 100 000 990 kr (excl. VAT); buy_mail_credits returns a payment link for the person.
- A brand has a head who invites the team; members work in the brand fully, on the head's mail credits. Co-hosts of one event edit it and run its guest list, but can't mail guests.
- Brands can sit under a main brand (Aperol and Hendrick's under Nigab, one level). The main brand is their admin: it sees all their events, their whole CRM (who said yes to which brand) and their statistics, and a team invited to it works in all of them. It makes no events and sends no mail itself: events are made in a brand, and each brand mails only the people who said yes to it. An event left on a main brand moves to a brand with move_event.
- Sign-in mail codes and links work only in the browser that asked for them.
